title: Correct linear velocity ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The final ratio for part (1) must be correctly simplified to √3 : 1 or an equivalent form.

title: Correct centripetal acceleration ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The final ratio for part (2) must be correctly simplified to √3 : 1 or an equivalent form.

title: Correct orbital radii identification
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the orbital radius for each point as R cos(latitude) for the northern point and R sin(latitude) for the southern point.

title: Application of v = ωr
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the relationship v = ωr to find the linear velocities, noting ω is the same for all points.

title: Application of a_c = ω²r
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for centripetal acceleration, a_c = ω²r, or an equivalent form, to find the ratio.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student's work should demonstrate that the calculated ratios are dimensionless.

title: Confusing latitude geometry
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses sin for the northern latitude or cos for the southern latitude when finding the orbital radius.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly introduces a negative sign for the velocity or acceleration magnitude ratio.
